summary: Iterative improvement plan to transform the Sovereign Council Orchestrator into the highest-clarity, simplest, fastest institutional desk: (1) Compact 1-line BLUF ribbon on Hubs 2–10 so active desks start above the fold, (2) Streamlined low-profile Command Bar with 1-click Quick Sovereign Switcher pills, (3) Smart Watchlist Sidebar auto-collapse on wide matrix/quant hubs, and (4) Global 'Simple Brief' vs. 'Pro Quant' density toggle with plain-English 3-bullet synthesis banners across all hubs.
